description: Three rules that each needed a shape the engine could not previously express. mktemp is a defect by existing -- there are no arguments to inspect and no safe way to call it -- so the rule matches the symbol alone. A file mode is wrong because of a BIT rather than a number, and 0o777, 0o666 and 0o1777 are all wrong for the same reason, so the rule tests the bit; 0o600 grants others nothing and is silent. And a format string is the same method with the operands swapped: the caller's data as an ARGUMENT is safe and as the RECEIVER is not, which is the same question the upload channel asks.

expected.note: hands back a name without creating anything, so the race is open
the caller supplies the format itself, and a format walks attributes
